speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have you noticed any specific patterns, such as worsening after sun exposure or with certain foods?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda. The combination of a chronic itchy rash on sun-exposed areas (face and upper body), sensory neuropathy in the hands, and exposure to liver-toxic environments like livestock and rice farming strongly suggests this condition. Please confirm if you have had any blisters or scarring on those rash areas.
